posts.subject: TTT Rule suggestion
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


I have a suggestion to add to TTT Rules.


Example:


OxygeN: If I die it's what, what, what.....


<OxygeN Slays himself>


People start calling KOS on WHAT because someone decided to troll

polls.question: *NEW* - You're not allowed to make someone look traitor

posts.bodyHtml:
I would consider that one as randomcalling and I'm not sure if it's only written in the jail rules, but plays like that or anti-social behaviour is not allowed.


If I see someone doing that, I will step in.


Sincerely, CyberTroniX

ofc it has to be me...always me


I do agree with @CyberTroniX all tho

posts.bodyHtml:
Don't know if it was @wickedy who told me that, but one of the higher Admins once told me that trolling in general is part of TTT.
I personally agree with that and I even more say that trolling increases the fun-level in TTT. Ofc you should limit trolling to an average level


Ich weiß nicht ob @wickedy das gesagt hat, aber einer der höheren Admins sagte, dass Trollen einfach dazu gehört bei TTT.
Ich seh das genauso, das trollen steigert meiner Meinung nach den Spielspaß. Natürlich sollte man das Trollen in grenzen halten.

hello


i agree with c, if someone calling your name loud then kill himself on console that is not only trolling that is kinda ruin the game on some level.
and when I see someone doing that I will just nicely ask him to stop because that might provoke someone.
and that is kinda random calling as well which is not allowed.
but i don't like this rule ''You're not allowed to make someone look traitor'' to be add because I don't see a point it is already not allowed, and it might confuse people Example:
Mason word : if i die is red zone
red zone kill me and he run away someone prove me red zone is KOS.
that should be definitely allowed but if we add this rule it will be confusing in my opinion with this Example that I shared.




kind regards
Mason
